entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_11 (id BIGINT, name STRING, PRIMARY KEY (id))
entries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM T_DSJ_11 x, T_DSJ_11 y WHERE x.id <> y.id

entries.name: join_three_chain_composite_middle
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_12A (id BIGINT, x BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (id)) CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_12B (k1 BIGINT, k2 BIGINT, c BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (k1, k2)) CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_12C (id BIGINT, label STRING, PRIMARY KEY (id))
entries.query: SELECT a.id, c.label FROM T_DSJ_12A a, T_DSJ_12B b, T_DSJ_12C c WHERE a.x = b.k1 AND b.c = c.id ORDER BY a.id

entries.name: join_inner_on_filter_both_sides
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_13A (id BIGINT, region STRING, val BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (id)) CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_13B (cid BIGINT, parent BIGINT, score BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (cid))
entries.query: SELECT a.id, b.score FROM T_DSJ_13A a INNER JOIN T_DSJ_13B b ON a.id = b.parent WHERE a.region = 'us' AND b.score > 10 ORDER BY b.cid

entries.name: join_comma_multi_key
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_14A (k1 STRING, k2 BIGINT, val BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (k1, k2)) CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_14B (k1 STRING, k2 BIGINT, score BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (k1, k2))
entries.query: SELECT a.k1, a.k2, a.val, b.score FROM T_DSJ_14A a, T_DSJ_14B b WHERE a.k1 = b.k1 AND a.k2 = b.k2 ORDER BY a.k1, a.k2

entries.name: join_comma_string_key
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_15A (id BIGINT, code STRING, PRIMARY KEY (id)) CREATE TABLE T_DSJ_15B (cid BIGINT, code STRING, label STRING, PRIMARY KEY (cid))
entries.query: SELECT a.id, b.label FROM T_DSJ_15A a, T_DSJ_15B b WHERE a.code = b.code ORDER BY b.cid

entries.name: cte_select_ids_outer_filter
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_DSC_01 (id BIGINT, val BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (id))
entries.query: WITH x AS (SELECT id, val FROM T_DSC_01) SELECT id FROM x WHERE val > 25

entries.name: cte_two_ctes_comma_join_count
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_DSC_02A (id BIGINT, gid BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (id)) CREATE TABLE T_DSC_02B (gid BIGINT, label STRING, PRIMARY KEY (gid))
entries.query: WITH ax AS (SELECT id, gid FROM T_DSC_02A), bx AS (SELECT gid, label FROM T_DSC_02B) SELECT count(*) FROM ax, bx WHERE ax.gid = bx.gid

entries.name: cte_referenced_twice_val_self_join
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_DSC_03 (id BIGINT, val BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (id))
entries.query: WITH x AS (SELECT id, val FROM T_DSC_03) SELECT count(*) FROM x AS a, x AS b WHERE a.val = b.val AND a.id < b.id

entries.name: cte_projection_narrow_then_sum
entries.schema_template: CREATE TABLE T_DSC_04 (id BIGINT, region STRING, val BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (id))
entries.query: WITH us AS (SELECT id, val FROM T_DSC_04 WHERE region = 'us') SELECT sum(val) FROM us
